ev.q: A total of 6.5 million topical antifungal prescriptions, costing $231 million, were filled for Medicare Part D beneficiaries in 2021
Higher-volume prescribers wrote 44.2% (2.9 million) of all prescriptions.
Among 1,017,417 unique prescribers, 130,637 (12.8%) prescribed topical antifungals
The total cost for all topical antifungal prescriptions was $231 million.
The volume and percentage of topical antifungal prescriptions written by higher-volume prescribers compared with lower-volume prescribers
Using 2021 Medicare Part D data, CDC examined prescription volumes, rates, and costs for topical antifungals

methods_quotes.q: Higher-volume prescribers were defined as those within the top 10th percentile of prescriber-level topical antifungal prescriptions by volume.
The volume and percentage of topical antifungal prescriptions written by higher-volume prescribers compared with lower-volume prescribers
Prescription rates per 1,000 beneficiaries were calculated by drug and region
Prescription rates per prescriber were calculated by tabulating number of providers overall and by provider type
The data set excludes clinician records with <11 prescriptions.
